items.title: Charlie Gabriel interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: In fact I remember one time I was with Eureka band and George Lewis was playing right next to me.

ctx.x: What was it like interacting with those older fellas?

Well my dad was very disciplined. He’d say, “Now whatever they tell you to do you do.” So I didn’t rebel against none of them. In fact I remember one time I was with Eureka band and George Lewis was playing right next to me. I’m playing right next to George Lewis. And I must have been making a mistake or something or doing something, because I couldn’t play out of my head. I could read but when they played something out of their head then I’d be stumbling, you know, trying to play with them. So George Lewis said,…
You said you were a good reader, but not all that music was written out, was it?
